description: This file defines a module for interacting with the OpenCode Zen model catalog, including fetching models from an API with caching, resolving model aliases, determining API routes, and providing static fallback models. It also includes functions for model configuration and formatting.

methods.name: resolveOpencodeZenAlias
methods.description: Resolves a model alias to its full model ID, returning the input if no alias exists.

methods.name: resolveOpencodeZenModelApi
methods.description: Determines the API route for a given model ID based on its prefix.

methods.name: supportsImageInput
methods.description: Checks if a model supports image input based on its ID.

methods.name: getOpencodeZenStaticFallbackModels
methods.description: Provides a static list of fallback models when API fetch fails.

methods.name: fetchOpencodeZenModels
methods.description: Fetches models from the OpenCode Zen API with caching; falls back to static models on failure.

methods.name: clearOpencodeZenModelCache
methods.description: Clears the cached model list to force re-fetch.
